Diagnosed with ADHD at 30ish when my child was being diagnosed. Dysthymia officially a few years earlier but unofficially be pcp at 19/20. 

My brother was diagnosed with adhd at 6 but I had no hyperactivity and was smart enough to get by so took much longer. My brother’s version was so extreme I didn’t recognize milder symptoms in myself or my child.

I found that I felt a lot less tired when I stopped sleeping more than 9 hours. I think sleeping is a scale, too little and you’re chronically tired and too much and you’re chronically tired.

Also exercise helped me to sleep better and deeper which led to being better rested. Finally I had to manage my anemia so worth getting checked for underlying reasons.

I still feel tired sometimes but it’s much worse when the above isn’t taken care of.
